en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a quiet small town near a body of water. In the foreground is a long, one‑and‑a‑half‑storey wooden or brick house with a steep tiled roof, multiple chimneys and large rectangular windows. Dirt roads border the house, and across the road there is a small fenced park or garden densely planted with mature trees and a few paths. Behind this are more low houses partly obscured by trees, and in the distance a broad lake or river with low hills on the far shore. The image has a white border, light wear on the corners, and faint handwriting at the bottom edge that appears mirrored and is difficult to read.
